items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: So we call ourselves Duo Paloma.

ctx.x: And then I had, now my wife is a concert pianist from the Polish National Conservatory but she did her doctorate here in piano at Florida State and then a couple of years ago she decided she was going to be jazz. So she spends hours every day, hours with an S, every day, I mean like every, like seven days a week you know learning jazz tunes and just working on this with that great classical technique that she has. So we call ourselves Duo Paloma. And we were just a strictly classical duo playing the French…
Yeah, that’s a rare combination, to have someone who can live in both worlds like that.
